notes: Read session_orchestrator together with continuation_policy and SessionArtifactStore. Session-visible phase is surfaced through task_progress; kernel PhaseManager remains the phase SSOT and is bridged through canonical turn history and checkpoint state, not role-profile schema. Role object instantiation uses instantiate_role_runtime_object(InstantiateRoleRuntimeObjectCommandV1) to query roles.profile through GetRoleProfileQueryV1 and bind only profile/tool/prompt/data refs plus profile_fingerprint; roles.runtime does not own profile state. Role asset mount tables and capability ports reject roles.runtime, role adapter/kernel/profile/session cells, and kernelone.roles paths as owners; business assets and capabilities must be owned by their real business or platform state Cell and mounted only by public contract/ref. Role task-market lifecycle uses execute_role_task_market_lifecycle(ExecuteRoleTaskMarketLifecycleCommandV1) to translate role-bound claim/lease/ack/fail/requeue operations into runtime.task_market public contracts. Role capability invocation is latest-only: mounted ports validate role allow-lists, capability fingerprints, and command contracts, then delegate to target Cell public APIs such as runtime.task_market PublishTaskWorkItemCommandV1 / QueryTaskMarketStatusV1, runtime.projection RuntimeProjectionQueryV1, chief_engineer.blueprint GenerateTaskBlueprintCommandV1, code_intelligence.engine VerifyAstDependencyQueryV1, factory.verification_guard VerifyCompletionCommandV1, qa.audit_verdict RunQaAuditCommandV1 / ParseTracebackFramesCommandV1 / RunVisualQaAuditCommandV1, finops.budget_guard ReserveBudgetCommandV1, and policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardBatchQueryV1. Chief Engineer blueprint delegation carries mounted BlueprintDatabase, ArchConstraintMemo, and DiffMapArchive refs in typed command context/result metadata so roles.runtime never owns those assets. PM critical-path evaluation derives task DAG dependency edges, failed stages, projection refs, and mounted asset refs from runtime.task_market QueryTaskMarketStatusV1 results; it does not scan scattered files or own task state. QA pytest verification requires both role_id=qa and the QA capability fingerprint before building VerifyCompletionCommandV1, so misconfigured non-QA ports are rejected without calling factory.verification_guard. QA visual audit first queries llm.control_plane CheckLlmModelCapabilityQueryV1 and requires an explicit image_input capability ref before building RunVisualQaAuditCommandV1; text-only models return allowed=false and do not invoke QA. Architect boundary validation uses policy.permission EvaluatePermissionCommandV1, policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardBatchQueryV1, and architect.design GenerateArchitectureDesignCommandV1 through public services; sandbox denials return allowed=false. Role state commit uses commit_role_state(RoleStateCommitRequest) to bind an existing roles.kernel CommitReceipt ref to factory.cognitive_runtime RecordRuntimeReceiptCommandV1 and ExportHandoffPackCommandV1; roles.runtime stores refs only and does not create a second ledger, handoff system, or receipt store.
